Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated “Founding year of Sigma Xi: 1913,” conflating the year American Scientist began being published by Sigma Xi with the organization’s own founding year. This misinterpretation overrode evidence already surfaced (1886) and led to instructions aiming to confirm an incorrect year, reflecting a confusion between publication history and organizational founding and a failure to synthesize verified information.
